violated_contract: Every reader or validator of conversation redirect lineage must accept every shape the lineage writers actually persist. A validator must not reject, as structurally invalid, lineage that another production writer creates in normal operation.
canonical_prevention: Build the validator's fixtures from the real writers (run the ordinary sync absorb to create lineage, then flatten it), not from hand-shaped rows, and repair legitimate legacy shapes to the stricter invariant inside the same transaction behind a kill switch.
